title: Twin Earth NYC Entity
description: Universal entity format for every addressable object in the Twin Earth NYC simulation. Entities span persons, vehicles, infrastructure, anomalies, portals, and environmental props. Each entity carries a unique ID, spatial placement, semantic classification, affordance list, LOD tier, and an extensible component bag for system-specific data.

entity_id.description: Globally unique entity identifier. Format: ENT_{TYPE}_{REGION}_{hex-hash}. Example: ENT_PERSON_MIDTOWN_a3f7, ENT_PORTAL_HARLEM_00bc4e.

entity_type.description: Primary classification of this entity. Determines which subsystems process it: 'person' and 'vehicle' feed NPC/traffic, 'camera'/'signal'/'crosswalk'/'kiosk'/'door' feed IoT artifact layer, 'anomaly'/'portal' feed the multiverse engine, 'prop'/'billboard'/'landmark' feed the rendering and narrative layers.

position.description: World-space position in meters. Origin (0,0,0) is the southwest corner of the playable area at sea level.

rotation.description: Orientation as a unit quaternion. Defaults to identity (0,0,0,1) — facing north along +Z.

region.description: Named region this entity belongs to (e.g., 'midtown', 'harlem', 'financial_district'). Used for spatial partitioning, heat tracking, and LOD budgeting.

block.description: Optional finer-grained block identifier within the region. Matches street-grid block names (e.g., 'W42_7AV_8AV').

persistent.description: If true, this entity survives session boundaries and is saved to the persistent world store. Non-persistent entities are ephemeral (background crowd, transient vehicles).

semantic_class.description: Human-readable semantic tag for AI reasoning and observation classification. Examples: 'yellow_cab', 'fire_hydrant', 'street_lamp', 'dimensional_rift'.

material.description: Primary material for physics interaction and rendering. Affects sound propagation, damage modeling, and visual shaders.

affordances.description: Actions this entity supports. 'walk'/'drive'/'climb' indicate traversal surfaces. 'block' means it is an obstacle. 'interact' means the player can engage with it. 'observe' means it has line-of-sight sensing. 'emit_light' means it contributes to the lighting model. 'log_events' means it writes to the evidence ledger.

lod_tier.description: Level-of-detail tier. L0 = full detail (hero entities, nearby). L1 = reduced detail (mid-range). L2 = minimal detail (distant). CULLED = not rendered or simulated this frame.

components.description: Extensible component bag. Each key is a component type name (e.g., 'npc', 'artifact', 'portal', 'physics_body', 'render_mesh') and the value is component-specific data. This is the primary extension point for attaching subsystem-specific state to any entity.

tags.description: Freeform tags for query filtering. Examples: ['evidence_source', 'destructible', 'quest_critical', 'imported_from_alt_universe'].

owner_id.description: Optional entity_id of the owning entity (e.g., a door owned by a building, a camera owned by a precinct). Used for permission and chain-of-custody reasoning.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this entity was first instantiated in the simulation.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent mutation to any field on this entity.

vec3.title: Vector3
vec3.description: 3D vector in meters. Used for positions, velocities, and directions.

quat.title: Quaternion
quat.description: Unit quaternion for rotation. Must satisfy x^2+y^2+z^2+w^2 = 1 (within floating-point tolerance).
